RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday,  the December 8, 2006/Agrahayana 17, 1928 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Agriculture; Agro and Rural Industries; Chemicals and
Fertilizers; Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution;
Environment and Forests; Health and Family Welfare;
Railways; Small Scale Industries; Steel)
Total number of questions — 20
Revival of SSIs
*241. SHRI M.V. MYSURA REDDY:
Will the Minister of SMALL SCALE
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the small scale industries which are lying
closed and the number of such industries
that have availed subsidy;
(b) whether Government are
formulating any scheme for revival of the
above small scale industries;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) the steps taken by Government to
implement the above scheme in national
interest?
AIDS patients in Orissa and North
Eastern States
*242. MS. SUSHILA TIRIYA: Will the
Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a large number
of people in the country especially in
Orissa and North East States living with
HIV virus that causes AIDS, are struggling
for survival with hundreds dying with no
access to treatment;
(b) if so, whether the medicines are
expensive that poor people are unable to
afford; and
(c) the steps taken by Government in
this regard?
Ban on sale of Gutka
*243. SHRI B.K. HARIPRASAD: Will
the Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are seriously
considering a ban on manufacture and sale/
use of Gutka from new year;
(b) whether rumours of such a ban by
Government on Gutka have caused a steep
fall in Arecanut prices in the mandis of
Karnataka and whether Arecanut growers
are saddled with unsold stocks;
(c) whether in the Prevention of Food
Adulteration Act, the commodity Arecanut
used in the manufacture of Gutka is termed
as injurious to health whereas Arecanut has
curative and therapeutic properties as
proven over many generations; and
(d) whether there would be a similar
ban on tobacco and tobacco products like
cigarettes?

76
Price of milk
†*244. SHRI PYARELAL
KHANDELWAL: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the producers
of milk are not getting the proper price of
milk;
(b) whether it is also a fact that water is
being sold at a price higher than milk in our
country;
(c) if not, the details of efforts being
made by Government in this regard;
(d) whether Government are
contemplating on the possibility of
formulating a national policy on animal
husbandry;
(e) if so, the details thereof; and
(f) if not, the details of efforts being
made for the development of the basic
infrastructure for animal husbandry?
Travelling without tickets in trains
*245. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that relatives and
aides of Ministers and legislators have been
found travelling without tickets in trains
and consequently passengers with reserved
berths have been denied accommodation;
(b) if so, the details of such incidents
and the action taken in each case during
2005 and 2006; and
(c) what kind of instructions have been
issued to the Railway Authorities in this
regard to prevent recurrence of such
incidents?
Fresh approvals for field trials of GM
crops
*246. SHRI RAJEEV SHUKLA: Will
the Minister of ENVIRONMENT AND
FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) the Government's response
following a Supreme Court directive barring
it from issuing fresh approvals of field trials
of Genetically-Modified (GM) crops;
(b) whether Government propose to
direct independent enquiry into the long
term economic viability of GM crops in
the Indian environment;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
State-of-the art facilities at Buxur
station
†*247. SHRI BASHISTHA NARAIN
SINGH: Will the Minister of RAILWAYS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether his Ministry has worked
on a plan to provide State of the art facilities
like food plazas and ATMs etc. at some
railway stations;
(b) if so, whether this includes Buxur
railway station in Bihar;
(c) besides these facilities, what other
facilities are to be provided there; and
(d) by when these facilities are likely to
start working?
Pending rail projects of Uttar Pradesh
*248. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will
the Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased to
state:
(a) the details of railway projects from
Uttar Pradesh which are pending for
completion;

Total number of questions — 155

Declining area of arable land
†1794. SHRI SURENDRA LATH: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a)  the total area of arable land in the
country at present;
(b) the extent of decline in said arable
land that took place during the last three
years;
(c) to what extent agricultural
production have been affected due to the
said decline; and
(d) whether barren and Government's
land holding would be allotted for agriculture
purposes to expand the area of arable land?
Production of crops
†1795. SHRI SURENDRA LATH: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a)  the details of the crops the
production of which have increased and
the crops the production of which has
decreased during the last three years;
(b) the extent of decrease in the
production of wheat, pulses and sugarcane;
and
(c) the reasons for decrease in the
production and the steps being taken to
boost the production?
Agricultural crisis
1796. SHRI JANARDHANA
POOJARY:
SHRI MOINUL HASSAN:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE
be pleased to state:
(a)  whether it is a fact that there is an
agricultural crisis in the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor alongwith the effect of
globalisation in agrarian crisis;
(c) whether high rate of interest and
indebtness are the primary cause of suicide
among the farmers;
(d) if so, the measures proposed to be
taken by Government to alleviate the
problems being faced by the farmers;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

409
(e) whether there is some proposal to
bring private financiers under some
regulation and to revive cooperative system;
and
(f) if so, the details thereof?
Wheat production
†1797. SHRI BALAVANT ALIAS
BAL APTE:
SHRI SHREEGOPAL VYAS:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE
be pleased to state:
(a)  whether it is a fact that there has
been a perpetual shortfall in wheat
production in the country during last many
years;
(b) if so, the details of shortfall in wheat
production during last three years;
(c) whether it is a fact that with a view
to maintain the foodgrain stock at required
level Government have decided to import
wheat; and
(d) if so, the quantum of wheat imported
so far during this year and out of this the
quantum of wheat that has reached the
country?
Strengthening/Promoting
Agricultural Information System
1798. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a)  whether it is a fact that the
Department of Agriculture and Cooperation
is implementing a central scheme
'Strengthening/Promoting Agricultural
Information System';
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the steps proposed to be taken to
ensure that benefits of the scheme reach
the small and marginal farmers; and
(d) the present status of the scheme
and the amount of money spent on it, so
far?
Special package for farmers of Orissa
1799. MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE
be pleased to state:
(a)  whether the Orissa Government
proposes to announce a special package
for their beleaguered farmers, to help them
to increase farm production and export of
these commodities, especially in the tribal
dominated KBK region, with a view to
improve their living;
(b) whether the Centre also proposes
to extend financial and physical help to
this backward State to facilitate execution
of this project; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Stopping shifting cultivation
1800. SHRI LALHMING LIANA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a)  whether Government have under-
taken any ambitious step to stop shifting
cultivation in the tribal areas during the
Tenth Five Year Plan;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the States
covered under the scheme;
(c) how many tribal people were given
alternative employment under the scheme;
and
(d) the States/districts where shifting
cultivation is completely/partially stopped
due to this scheme?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

410
Sowing of rabi crop
†1801. SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD:
SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE
be pleased to state:
(a)  whether it is a fact that sowing of
wheat in the country for rabi crop during
the current year has been completed;
(b) if so, whether Government have
made any estimate of wheat production in
the ensuing season;
(c) if so, the total quantity of wheat
estimated to be produced; and
(d) the estimated rate of production of
wheat in this regard?
Land under wheat cultivation

PRASAD:
DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE
be pleased to state:
(a)
